messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Morning all.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Morning. Kettle's on.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Repo is up, you should both have invites. Branch protection is on main so everything goes through a PR.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Got it, thanks.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: I've started on the room availability queries. Nothing to show yet.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Can someone confirm whether we're on Postgres 16 or 15 for local dev? My compose file says 15.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: 16. I'll update the compose file today, mine drifted.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: The seed script is failing on my machine. Alembic says target database is not up to date and then just stops.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Run alembic upgrade head first. I should have written that down somewhere.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: That did it.

messages.author: Dilini Rajapaksa
messages.text: Anyone know if we're still paying for the old staging box?

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: I think so. I'll check the billing next week.

messages.author: Nuwan Jayasuriya
messages.text: Joining this channel, hello. I'm picking up the invoicing PDF work from Thursday.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Welcome Nuwan.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Right, decided: we're using Postgres 16 everywhere, local and staging. No more version drift.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Lunch was a mistake.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: Blocked on the room availability endpoint. The bookings table has no index on check_in_date and the query takes 40 seconds on the seed data. I can't test anything until that's sorted.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Nuwan, can you write the migration for that index? You're closest to the query.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: Will do.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/indexes-multicolumn.html

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: nice one

messages.author: Dilini Rajapaksa
messages.text: Reminder that the office wifi is being replaced on Friday, so work from home if you can.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Morning.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: Index migration is merged. Query is down to 80ms.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Are we doing soft deletes on bookings or actually removing the row? It changes how I write the cancellation flow.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Soft delete I'd say. Hotels get audited and a deleted booking is exactly the thing someone asks about six months later.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: I'd rather hard delete and keep an audit table separately. Mixing deleted rows into every query is how you end up with bugs where cancelled rooms still show as occupied.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Both have a point. Can we park it until Friday? I can work around it either way for now.

messages.author: Dilini Rajapaksa
messages.text: The staging SSL certificate expires on the 24th. Nobody has renewed it and I don't have access to the registrar account.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: I have access. I'll do it before the weekend.

messages.author: Nuwan Jayasuriya
messages.text: Quick question, is the invoice number format decided? Sequential per hotel or global?

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Per hotel. Global would leak how many bookings we're doing across all clients.

messages.author: Nuwan Jayasuriya
messages.text: Makes sense, thanks.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: brb

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: Esandu, could you review PR 41 when you get a chance? It's the availability endpoint, about 200 lines.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Will look this afternoon.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: Ignore that for now, I found a bug in the date handling and I'm reworking it. I'll ping you when it's ready again.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Righto.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Heading off, back on early tomorrow.

messages.author: Nuwan Jayasuriya
messages.text: Morning both. Or all five of you.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: The Gemini API key we're using for the pricing prototype has hit its daily quota. Every request is coming back 429 and I can't run the comparison until it resets tonight.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Can you put the key rotation on the list? Two keys and we'd have twice the headroom.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Adding it.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Decision from the call just now: Phase 1 ships without the AI pricing feature. It goes in Phase 2 once the OTA data question is answered.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: Good. That was going to sink the timeline.

messages.author: Dilini Rajapaksa
messages.text: Who is on support this weekend?

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Me I think. I'll double check the rota.

messages.author: Nuwan Jayasuriya
messages.text: The PDF library we picked doesn't support Sinhala characters and half the guest names in the test data are in Sinhala. Invoices come out as boxes. I've stopped work on it until we choose another one.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: That's a proper problem. Haritha, can you look at what the alternatives are? You did the font work on the last project.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Yes, I'll have a shortlist by tomorrow.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Anyone want coffee

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: always

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Settled on soft deletes for bookings, with a deleted_at column and a default scope that excludes them. Ranidu's audit concern is handled by the same column.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Fine by me.

messages.author: Nuwan Perera
messages.text: PR 41 is ready for review again, date handling fixed.

messages.author: Dilini Rajapaksa
messages.text: Certificate renewed, staging is fine until next September.

messages.author: Haritha Silva
messages.text: Right, that's me. Good day all.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Did you see what Haritha said about the deletes? I still think she's wrong.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Take it to the channel, not here.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Fair enough.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Are we paying Nuwan J the same rate as Nuwan P?

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: Let's talk about that offline, not in writing.

messages.author: Esandu Meth
messages.text: Can you handle standup tomorrow, I have a dentist appointment.

messages.author: Ranidu Fernando
messages.text: No problem.
